description: Reads one page and lists every tracking tag in the page code with its IDs: Meta Pixel, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, Snap, Microsoft UET, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Klaviyo, Clarity and Hotjar. On Shopify it also reads app pixels from the sandboxed web pixel config and counts custom pixels. Returns consent tools, server-side tracking hints and issues such as a Meta Pixel loading twice, several GA4 IDs, GA4 next to GTM, or no consent tool. It reads code only and cannot see whether events fire; the free Tracking Doctor Chrome extension does that. One GET request, counts against the free daily limit unless cached.

url.description: Any page URL or a store domain, for example store.com

name: check_tracking_pixels
title: Check the tracking pixels and tags on a page
